summary.plain: The building at Fermilab, near Chicago, where the Mu2e experiment is being built: a chain of three giant superconducting magnets that will search for a muon turning directly into an electron.
summary.technical: Mu2e experimental hall on the Fermilab site, housing the production, transport and detector solenoids, straw tracker, crystal calorimeter and cosmic ray veto of the Mu2e experiment. No building-specific sourced coordinate was found this session; recorded as a campus-level approximate point.
